summary.en: 1950s format: blues–country–R&B compressed into three-minute singles.
summary.zh: 1950s 格式：蓝调–乡村–R&B 压缩成三分钟单曲。

body.en: Rock 'n' Roll merges Blues, Country, and R&B into short, danceable records aimed at teens. It sets the guitar–bass–drums band as a youth product and hands the British Invasion a reusable song and riff vocabulary.
body.zh: Rock 'n' Roll 把 Blues、Country 与 R&B 合成面向青少年的短舞曲唱片。它把吉他–贝斯–鼓乐队定为青年产品，并为 British Invasion 提供可复用的歌曲与 Riff 语汇。
